title: Offset tip-mass beam under measured harmonic base displacement
source: Wang Hongjin, Meng Qingfeng, Feng Wuwei (2014), Shock and Vibration 981053, Tables 2–3 and section 4.2; https://doi.org/10.1155/2014/981053 ; only published measurements/parameters, independently meshed.

quantities.quantity: Absolute peak displacement at x=0.0364 m
quantities.reason: 5% predeclared for measured peak response: sensor position, rounded geometry/inertia, shear/rotary inertia; no fit to these amplitudes.
quantities.known_failure: Unresolved model-to-measurement amplitude mismatch (78–81% high), unchanged by 40→80 beam refinement and 20→40 modes. An independent Euler–Bernoulli boundary-value calculation with the published mass, eccentricity, centroidal inertia and 0.01 mm base amplitude predicts a 1.89846 mm tip peak, close to the FEM 1.89934 mm but not the measured 1.0671 mm. The excitation relation in Eq. 43 needs reconciliation; no damping or input amplitude is fitted, and the original 5% tolerance is retained.
